messages:
maya: Quick async capstone check for Q3 OKRs — what shipped vs slipped? Need owners for the three remaining items by EOD. TL;DR: embeddings cache rollout shipped, billing telemetry slipped, runtime v3 canary partial. Who owns billing telemetry fix? @jordan?
jordan: I can take billing telemetry. Blocker: stripe webhook payload mismatch (legacy vs new). I have a patch but need a quick CR from @lee.
lee: I can review in ~2hrs. Please add a minimal repro in the PR.
jordan: Added repro + unit test. FYI CI has a failing e2e: ```ERR: webhook: missing field 'plan_id'``` — looks like legacy payload still sent from some merchants.
sam: Design note — the billing UI tweak is optional for the OKR metric. If backend fix lands we can ship without UX polish and schedule UI follow-up next sprint.
maya: :thumbsup: Good—that reduces scope. Runtime v3 canary status?
ankit: Runtime v3 canary: kernel dedupe landed, perf looks good on T4 in short-run benchmarks. We see flakes under long-seq tests. Owner is eng-runtime (lee) for stability. Next step: run one canary node with KV cache toggled off to isolate.
lee: I'll run the long-seq harness tonight and post logs. If flakes persist I'll open a rollback PR for the kernel change.
maya: Owners summary for follow-ups: billing telemetry -> jordan (CR: lee), long-seq stability -> lee + eng-runtime, analytics dashboard -> sam + maya. Any outstanding CR blockers?
jordan: CR requested @lee, and we need integrations sign-off for the schema mapping (cc @sam).
sam: Integrations okay from product POV. I'll draft a migration blurb for release notes.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Canary deploy scheduled for 2026-04-15 03:00 UTC — will skip node with KV toggle if rollback flag set.
maya: Next steps: jordan -> finalize fix and push; lee -> CR by EOD; ankit -> run canary isolation tomorrow morning; sam -> draft release-note; I'll consolidate and send an exec update by 11am PST. If anything slips, flag here immediately.
lee: Done CR, left one minor comment. Unit tests green; long-seq e2e still running.
jordan: Thanks — linked PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/892 (added repro). Will ping @lee after e2e.
sam: :memo: Release-note draft here: https://docs.google.com/document/d/placeholder — will share an excerpt once complete.
maya: Decision check: if long-seq remains flaky after harness, we rollback the kernel change for canary and ship the billing telemetry fix. Sound good? :white_check_mark:
ankit: Agreed — will prepare rollback playbook just in case.
maya: Perfect. I'll post the exec summary after the CRs land. Thanks all.
